name: stagecraft
summary: Stagecraft reveals a poetic fusion of softness and structure. The body and single accent pillow are dressed in an elegantly textured fabric, while the refined yellow copper-brushed stainless steel detail introduces a graceful metallic counterpoint. This contrast of warmth and precision evokes a sense of tailored luxury. 72.5x84x72
